RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

An all-male panel is common in structural engineering and does not alone prove discrimination, but combined with your substantially greater experience (15 vs. 8 years) and the employer's silence, unconscious affinity bias may have played a role. However, head-of-group positions heavily weigh commercial factors like client relationships and revenue generation, where the successful candidate may have presented strong credentials.

Whether to raise it depends on your goals. Accusing the panel of bias without direct evidence risks harming your professional reputation if you plan to stay or remain in this network. Instead, follow up firmly on the written feedback first. If you contemplate legal action, consult an employment attorney before mentioning the panel's composition.
